about: The zone's endless open ground (Dom 2026-10-27: no visible pit; the hero roams like an MMO). The page drew a 400-unit floor (data/stage.json ground.size) scaled with the pit (world.pitScale in data/respawn.json) and centred on the pit, so it ended about 130 m out and its grid 26 m out. In the zone the same floor (same material, colour and fog, no texture) is made wide and FOLLOWS the hero: groundFollow.on moves the floor, its grid and the sun (so the shadow frustum stays on him) to the hero each frame, snapped to snapMetres, rounded up to a whole number of the stage's grid cells so the grid lines and the sand stay fixed in the world while he runs (no swim, no seam). groundRadiusMetres: metres of floor on every side of that point. gridRadiusMetres: how far the same grid is laid around it; beyond it the plain floor (a grid hundreds of lines deep only shimmers on a phone). edgeVisibility: the share of the floor's colour the fog may still show at the floor's edge (FogExp2, data/stage.json duel.fogDensity); the floor's edge is groundRadiusMetres from the hero, so it must be at least the distance where the fog is down to this and the edge is fog, not a line. cameraFarMetres: the zone camera's far plane (it was 180 m for the pit), at least that fog distance. With groundFollow.on false the floor stays centred on the pit and groundRadiusMetres must also clear the walking reach (postKill.walkRadiusMetres + cameraMetres once the free walk is in). The pit has no wall, rim or ring drawn on this stage (src/arena-stage.ts: the floor and the sky; the 'boundary' ring is hidden below full size, src/fight/scene.ts), so there is nothing to remove: the pit's edge is only the sim's circle. ?ground=v1 = the pit's floor exactly as before (?postkill=v1 builds no zone, so also unchanged). The page keeps drawing in the sim's own coordinates (doubles in the sim, matrices in doubles on the CPU): only the ground and the sun are re-centred on the hero.
